text:
incident-bot: Pager fired — latency.p99 > 1.2s (5m) in eu-west. Primary on-call: @sam oncall.
sam oncall: ack
pagerduty-bot: Page acknowledged by sam oncall (ACK ID: PD12345). Escalation scheduled in 10m if not resolved.
nina sre: noticing p95 up ~250ms but p99 is spiking >1s. No 500s in app logs yet. Probably tail latency.
kim infra: metric spike correlates with kv-proxy queue depth on eu-west-1: queue_depth -> 850 (baseline 120). Also seeing increased batching latency.
lee eng: rolled back canary ~3m before alert. Canary rollback traffic might have concentrated to fewer instances; could explain fanout to cold shards.
sam oncall: taking ownership — will disable large-batching policy (autoscaler config) on inference-fanout podset and add hot-pool nodes. executing now.
kim infra: hitting reserved GPU quota in eu-west for hot-pool +5. Kicking fallback: start routing non-PHI traffic to us-east as temporary measure.
sam oncall: command: ```kubectl -n inference patch hpa fanout-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'``` applying
lee eng: +1 to disabling batching; add config snippet for immediate test: ```PATCH /v1/config/batching {"max_batch_latency_ms":10}```
pagerduty-bot: Note: escalation to L2 in 7m unless acknowledged by an L2.
kim infra: autoscaler fired, starting 4 hot nodes in eu-west; queued pods scheduled. GPU quota nearing limit; fallback routing active.
nina sre: customer impact: several customers reported higher response times in EU region for chat completions; no errors but delayed responses >2s. Logged support tickets: #3456 #3457
sam oncall: monitoring: p99 down from 1.3s -> 760ms after disabling batching. p95 steady at ~220ms. Continuing to observe for 10m.
lee eng: suggestion for follow-up: implement adaptive batching threshold per shard to prevent fanout when capacity drops.
sam oncall: pagerduty: marking optical ack -> will not escalate. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded (ACK ID: PD12345). Escalation cancelled.
incident-bot: Incident auto-notes: latency p99 spike mitigated via batching config + hot-pool scale. Create postmortem if follow-up required.
nina sre: filing postmortem ticket and assigning to lee eng and kim infra. Will include timeline and mitigation steps.
sam oncall: closing thread; will push a short runbook note to the oncall playbook for batch->scale interactions.
kim infra: small follow-up: will request temporary quota bump for eu-west and document fallback routing policy.
lee eng: adding draft eval for adaptive batching heuristics to reduce tail impact.
sam oncall: thanks team. good catch. closing. :pray:
